visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Builder Instead of Telescoping Constructors
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Three constructors with growing parameter lists create the same class, and a call like new Pizza("large", true, 3) does not say what true or 3 mean. Use a builder with named steps. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Each option is named at the call site, any subset can be given in any order, and adding a new option does not need another constructor.
